global_invariants: All variables and equations must have declared dimensions/normalizations.
The perturbed conservation/Bianchi accounting must close under the declared interaction policy.
The homogeneous limit must reproduce the versioned RLL background implementation.
Gauge conventions and initial conditions must be explicit and map consistently between independent solvers.
No numerical epsilon may silently substitute for a missing physical relation.
Negative or unstable limiting tests are retained as evidence and block promotion.
required_tests_before_token_resolution: linear stability/finite-evolution test over the declared parameter box

implementation_handoff.unlock_condition: C01-C08 must move from UNASSIGNED_PHYSICAL_ASSUMPTION to versioned equations/rules and all required analytic/limiting tests must pass.
implementation_handoff.independence_rule: CLASS and CAMB implementations must be written as independent solver integrations against the same frozen closure contract; generated outputs may not be shared as implementation inputs.

resolved_content: The missing degrees of freedom, required decisions, falsifiers, solver handoff and test gates are fully enumerated. The physical closure equations themselves remain intentionally unassigned rather than invented.
